import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('dataset.csv')

# Calculate average spending across different product categories
spending_columns = [col for col in data.columns if col.startswith('Mnt')]
average_spending = data[spending_columns].mean()

# Create a bar plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.barplot(x=average_spending.index, y=average_spending.values, palette='viridis')
plt.title('Average Monthly Spending by Product Category')
plt.ylabel('Average Spending (€)')
plt.xlabel('Product Category')
plt.xticks(rotation=15)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png')
plt.close()
